[[File:EmergencyBeacon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An emergency beacon]]
{{Quote|Have you located the ''source'' of the ''distress beacon''?''"<br />"''It appears to be an ''Imperial escape pod'', your ''Highness''. ''One'' lifeform on board.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]|<ref name="Leia's Trust">{{SWComicCite|7.12|Leia's Trust}}</ref>}}
An '''emergency beacon''', also known as a '''distress beacon''' or a '''rescue beacon''', was a type of [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] that was designed for use in emergency situations to summon or locate aid. Alliance operatives used them when they were in trouble, signaling other members of the Alliance during times of distress. Sometime before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], when [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was preparing for a diplomatic mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] forced Leia Organa to take an emergency beacon with her. The gesture proved to be life-saving, as Organa was attacked and captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] led by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Marcellin Wessel]]. Due to the emergency beacon, Organa was able to be rescued with the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
